instrument_name: NCDOR Withholding Tax Frequently Asked Questions
figure_or_rule_carried: Nonresident employee is subject to NC withholding on wages for services performed in NC, except not required if the other state requires its own withholding; certificates NC-4 EZ, NC-4, NC-4 NRA, federal W-4 not acceptable; no certificate means single with no allowances; on returns round withholding to the nearest dollar (25.49 to 25.00, 25.50 to 26.00). FAQ does not mention reciprocal agreements or local income tax.

GEN-58 authorizes a power of attorney (individuals and businesses); GEN-58R revokes; separate AV-63 / AV-59 for ad valorem. NC DES power of attorney for UI not located. No state calculator located beyond the NC-30 tables.

instrument_name: G.S. 95-25.13 Notification and record keeping (Wage and Hour Act)
figure_or_rule_carried: Subdivision (4): employer shall furnish each employee an itemized statement of deductions made under G.S. 95-25.8 for each pay period such deductions are made; notice in writing at least one pay period before changes in promised wages (subdivision 3). No gross/net/hours stub requirement in the text read. Last amendment cited 2021-82 s.7.
